summary: Backend and frontend regression testing executed for latest Barang page/table update. Core create/read/update field flows work, add modal opens, edit modal opens, delete action is inside edit modal, and table+toolbar render. Found one critical backend authorization gap and one frontend testability blocker.

critical.issue: Non-admin user (kasir) can update inventory item successfully (HTTP 200). This conflicts with admin-only edit requirement.

ui_bugs.issue: Close/delete action buttons in edit modal do not have stable testID attributes, causing brittle mobile automation and selector timeout after delete-confirm section opened.

integration_issues.flow: Admin opens edit modal -> opens delete confirmation -> closes modal
integration_issues.issue: After delete confirmation section opens, automation timed out on close action selector in 3 attempts (loop prevention reached). Functional crash not observed, but deterministic closure path was not fully completed in automation.

action_items: Restrict PUT /api/items/{item_id} to admin role (use get_admin_user dependency) to align with admin-only edit requirement.
Add explicit testID for edit modal action buttons: close and delete entry button for reliable mobile regression automation.
Optionally add explicit root-level testID for inventory table header/body containers to simplify sticky-header checks.
Stabilize Expo tunnel startup; expo.err.log still shows intermittent ngrok/tunnel connection failures.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py currently protects item delete with admin guard, but item update uses generic authenticated guard; this creates privilege mismatch.
frontend/app/(tabs)/inventory.tsx correctly hides add/edit UI for non-admin via isAdmin checks.
frontend/.env currently defines EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL but not EXPO_BACKEND_URL (policy mismatch with testing instruction).

success_rate.frontend: 70% (most admin inventory checks passed; one modal-close path blocked by selector stability)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_* inventory items during API/UI tests; backend pytest fixture cleaned API-created records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Loop prevention reached on the same modal close selector after opening delete confirmation (3 attempts). Do not repeat same selector strategy; add stable testIDs for edit modal action buttons before re-running full UI flow.
rca_of_issue: RCA-1 (critical): backend update item endpoint uses get_current_user instead of get_admin_user, so kasir can still update via API even if UI hides edit button. Repro: login kasir -> PUT /api/items/{id} with valid payload -> returns 200. Mitigation: enforce admin dependency on update endpoint and add regression test. RCA-2 (UI automation blocker): edit modal close/delete controls rely on text-based selectors only; after modal scroll/delete confirm state changes, deterministic selector interaction became unstable in automation runs.
